name: facebookresearch_assemblyhands-toolkit/calib/AGENT.python.tools.md

facebookresearch_assemblyhands-toolkit/c.transform_3d_points_with_affine: use transform3 to apply an affine transformation matrix to an array of 3D points
facebookresearch_assemblyhands-toolkit/c.transform_3d_vectors_without_translation: use transform_vec3 to apply rotation and scale to 3D vectors ignoring translation
facebookresearch_assemblyhands-toolkit/c.convert_3x4_to_4x4_homogeneous: use as_4x4 to convert a 3x4 affine matrix into a 4x4 homogeneous matrix
facebookresearch_assemblyhands-toolkit/c.normalize_vectors_to_unit_length: use normalized to return unit-length copies of vectors along a specified axis
facebookresearch_assemblyhands-toolkit/c.batch_transform_multiple_points: use transform3 with batched affine matrices and point arrays that are broadcastable

facebookresearch_assemblyhands-toolkit/c.create_OpenCVCameraModel: create an OpenCVCameraModel instance with width, height, focal length, optical center, and distortion coefficients
facebookresearch_assemblyhands-toolkit/c.create_OV62CameraModel: create an OV62CameraModel fisheye camera instance with width, height, focal length, center, and distortion params
facebookresearch_assemblyhands-toolkit/c.load_camera_from_json: load a CameraModel from a JSON string or dict containing calibration parameters and extrinsics
facebookresearch_assemblyhands-toolkit/c.project_world_to_window: call world_to_window on a CameraModel to project 3D world points to 2D image coordinates
facebookresearch_assemblyhands-toolkit/c.update_camera_extrinsics: call update_extrinsics on a CameraModel to update the camera position and orientation in world space

facebookresearch_assemblyhands-toolkit/c.project_3d_to_2d_perspective: use PerspectiveProjection.project to map 3D eye-space vectors to 2D normalized image coordinates
facebookresearch_assemblyhands-toolkit/c.project_3d_with_depth_perspective: use PerspectiveProjection.project3 to project 3D vectors to 2D while preserving the Z depth component
facebookresearch_assemblyhands-toolkit/c.project_fisheye_arctan: use ArctanProjection.project to apply fisheye arctan projection on 3D vectors for wide FOV over 180 degrees
facebookresearch_assemblyhands-toolkit/c.unproject_fisheye_2d_to_3d: use ArctanProjection.unproject to convert 2D fisheye-projected coordinates back into 3D direction vectors
facebookresearch_assemblyhands-toolkit/c.evaluate_opencv_distortion: use OpenCVDistortion.evaluate to apply Brown-Conrady radial and tangential distortion to 2D points with k1-k3 and p1-p2 coefficients
facebookresearch_assemblyhands-toolkit/c.evaluate_ov62_fisheye_distortion: use OV62Distortion.evaluate to apply OVRFisheye62 distortion with 6 radial and 2 tangential coefficients to 2D points
